prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every homeowner — the right choice depends on your location inside Dallas, roof type and material you want, budget, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and whether you value long warranties or quickest turnaround. I can help you pick a top contractor for your situation — tell me your ZIP code and whether you’re using insurance — but meanwhile here’s a practical way to find the best company and what to check.

How to find the best roofer in Dallas for a replacement
- Focus on local, licensed, and insured contractors with good recent reviews and verifiable references.
- Prefer contractors with manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster) — those certifications mean better training, extended warranties, and accountability.
- Check state/local licensing and insurance: TX doesn’t require a statewide roofing license, so confirm business registration, general liability insurance, and workers’ comp or a policy that covers employees.
- Look for experience with Dallas permits, code, and storm/insurance claims if that’s relevant.

Questions to ask every candidate
1. Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide certificates?  
2. Are you a certified installer for the shingle/metal/flat roofing brand I want? (Ask for certification proof.)  
3. Can you provide recent local references and photos of completed jobs?  
4. What’s included in the price (tear-off, underlayment, ventilation, ice/water shield, disposal)?  
5. Will you pull permits and handle inspections?  
6. What warranties do you offer (manufacturer vs. workmanship length and transferability)?  
7. Do you provide a written estimate with a clear scope, timeline, and payment schedule?  
8. Who will be my job-site contact and how do you handle unexpected issues?

Red flags
- High-pressure sales, demand for full payment up front, or only accepting cash.
- Vague written estimates, no permit handling, no references, or no proof of insurance.
- Unwillingness to provide a written warranty or contract.

Typical pricing and timeline (ballpark)
- Costs vary by roof size, pitch, materials, and tear-off complexity. For Dallas area residential asphalt shingle replacements, many full replacements commonly fall in the mid-thousands to low tens-of-thousands of dollars. Get at least 3 written bids.
- Typical job time: 1–4 days (single-family house) plus a few days for inspection/cleanup depending on scope.

How I can help right now
- If you give your ZIP code and whether the replacement is insurance-related, I can shortlist well-reviewed Dallas-area roofers and what to expect from each.
- Or I can draft an email or checklist you can use to request estimates from contractors.

Would you like me to find a short list of contractors near you? If so, share your ZIP code and any preferences (material, budget, insurance claim).
